items.title: UK government rejects national consultation on AI datacenters
items.excerpt: The UK government rejected calls for a UK-wide public consultation on the environmental impact of AI datacenters, even though a petition passed 39,000 signatures. Ministers pointed to environmental checks done project by project instead.

items.title: Microsoft: Hackers in China, N Korea using ARTEX AI tool to break into global tech systems
items.excerpt: Microsoft threat intelligence says state-linked actors in China and North Korea are using ARTEX, an agentic offensive AI framework that automates familiar attack techniques. Weak defenses can be breached in minutes.

items.title: India's government ponders cradle to grave AI oversight
items.excerpt: Uttar Pradesh, India's most populous state, issued a 178-page tender for a government 'AI Stack'. It would link agency data through each household's Family ID to power a dozen AI use cases, from social-media complaint monitoring to police case lookups.

items.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users' chats
items.excerpt: A bipartisan coalition of 42 state attorneys general filed objections to block the sale of Character.AI users' chat logs, including minors' data, in the company's bankruptcy auction. DUP-RISK: politics already published ctnewsjunkie CT challenge on 2026-11-25; keep only if this is a distinct multistate filing.

items.title: We'd be 'stupid' not to: Poland defends $300M military AI deal with Palantir
items.excerpt: Poland's defense minister defended a $300 million procurement of Palantir's military AI system, saying it would be 'wrong' not to use the software despite concerns about reliance on American technology.

items.title: AI is straining America's open records systems
items.excerpt: Startups are mining public records for AI products and citizens are using chatbots to file far more requests, which is overwhelming US freedom-of-information offices and pushing agencies to rethink public-records rules.

items.title: Government of Canada boosts AI innovation from Canadian SMEs with $700 million expansion of the AI Compute Access Fund
items.source: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
items.excerpt: AI Minister Evan Solomon added C$700M to the AI Compute Access Fund under Canada's Sovereign AI Compute Strategy, bringing it to C$1B. A health and life sciences call for proposals is open, there are added incentives for Canadian-owned compute, and C$52M goes to 45 more companies. Off-list primary document.

items.title: Parliamentary inquiry pushes for ban on election AI deepfakes
items.excerpt: A bipartisan Australian parliamentary inquiry called for a committee to examine changes to electoral law that would outlaw deepfakes in election material and political ads. Off-list outlet.

items.title: '경남지사 선거 딥페이크 의혹' 12명 송치…박완수 지사 불송치
items.excerpt: 경찰이 6·3 지방선거 당시 경남지사 후보 캠프에서 불거진 딥페이크 영상·관권선거 의혹 수사를 마치고 캠프 관계자와 공무원 등 12명을 송치했고, 박완수 지사는 불송치했다. 외부 매체(off-list).

items.title: 안철수, '중국발 AI 봇 폭주 방지법' 발의
items.excerpt: 안철수 의원이 중국발 AI 봇처럼 운영 주체를 알기 어려운 자동화 프로그램이 국내 인터넷 서비스에 대량 접속하는 문제에 대응하는 법안을 대표발의했다. 정부의 정기 실태조사와 대응 체계 마련이 핵심이다. 외부 매체(off-list).

items.title: 행안부, 공공 AI 가이드라인 29개 기준 배포
items.excerpt: 행정안전부가 11월 25일 중앙행정기관·지방정부·공공기관에 「공공 AI 서비스 UI/UX 가이드라인」을 배포했다. AI임을 먼저 밝히고 중요한 선택은 이용자가 직접 하도록 하는 29개 설계 기준을 담았다. 외부 매체(off-list). 원문 보도자료는 mois.go.kr.

items.title: House Lawmakers Introduce Bill Requiring Reports on AI-Built Models
items.excerpt: Reps. Josh Gottheimer and Nathaniel Moran introduced the bipartisan Recursive Self-Improvement Safety Act on Nov 24. Developers above a compute threshold who spent $100M+ on training would file quarterly reports on AI involvement and human oversight in R&D with a new Commerce office, with civil penalties up to $10M. Off-list; primary not located.

items.title: Indonesia prepares 3 measures to address US AI chip export controls
items.excerpt: Indonesian Communication and Digital Affairs Minister Meutya Hafid said the government has prepared three measures in response to tighter US export controls on advanced AI chips, after reports that Nvidia halted server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries. Off-list outlet.

items.title: Singapore says it is 'engaging' with firms on exports
items.excerpt: Singapore said it is 'engaging' with local businesses over tightened US export controls on Nvidia's advanced AI chips, but could not confirm reports that Nvidia halted server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries. Off-list outlet; same running story as the Indonesia item.

items.title: Taiwan election: Is China behind a wave of AI fakes and disinformation?
items.excerpt: BBC Verify found a China-linked network repeatedly targeting Taiwan's ruling DPP, including President Lai and mayoral candidate Shen, with AI videos spreading false claims ahead of the Nov 28 local elections. Off-list outlet.

items.title: Fact check: Deepfakes and 'US abandons Taiwan' claims spread ahead of vote
items.excerpt: DW fact-checks deepfakes and 'US abandons Taiwan' narratives circulating before Taiwan's Nov 28 local elections. Off-list outlet; same story as the BBC Verify item, so pick one.

items.title: Enforce AI nudifier ban, MEPs warn
items.excerpt: 81 MEPs demanded that the EU AI Act's ban on AI 'nudifier' apps be enforced from day one when it takes effect next week. Euractiv's EU-affairs feed now publishes under rapporteur.com. Date verified via the reader proxy; the body is behind Cloudflare.

items.title: 러시아 소버린 AI 지원 계획...자국 모델 지원 4대 요건 제시
items.excerpt: 푸틴 러시아 대통령이 26일 '2036년까지의 러시아 AI 국가전략' 갱신과 국가 행동계획 승인을 지시하고, 자국 AI 모델 지원 요건 4가지를 제시했다. 국내 모바일 운영체제에 AI 모델·에이전트 선택 화면을 의무화하는 방안도 포함됐다. 외부 매체(off-list).

items.title: 靑 AI수석 "시험에 AI 불법활용시 기업에도 법적책임 생길 수도"
items.excerpt: 이해민 청와대 AI미래기획수석이 AI를 활용한 시험 부정행위 대책과 관련해 국제 공조를 점검하고 있다고 밝혔다. AI 서비스가 불법 전송에 쓰이면 기업도 법적 책임을 질 수 있다는 점을 명시하는 방안을 언급했다. 외부 매체(off-list).

items.title: What Happened to the China-US AI Talks?
items.excerpt: Analysis of the stalled US-China intergovernmental AI dialogue. This is commentary, not a new decision, so it is low priority. Date verified via the reader proxy; the body is behind Cloudflare.
